entries.task: Session 1 writes docs/planning/solution-plan.md from the brief in docs/planning/brief.md and nothing else: one paragraph on ContosoUniversity as found -- an ASP.NET MVC 5 application on .NET Framework 4.8.1 in non-SDK project files with packages.config under src\, the solution at src\ContosoUniversity.sln, feature folders under src\ContosoUniversity\Features, a DBDeployment project for RoundhousE, and Fixie 1 integration tests in src\IntegrationTests run by the Fixie console that dabbler.yaml's dotnet-framework suite already declares -- and one section per change: the calculator page (a Features\Calculator folder with a controller, a view and the arithmetic, reached by the default route and linked from the layout, tested in IntegrationTests and listed in both .csproj files), and the documentation comments on what that change added, with nothing else changed. It says each change is shown to work by the compile control's MSBuild build and the Fixie suite, and that the existing failing CreateTests.Should_create is out of scope.

Session 2 appends two numbered sessions to docs/sessions/session-plan.md from docs/planning/solution-plan.md and writes nothing else: Session 3, the calculator page -- the Calculator arithmetic, its UiController and Index view in a new Features\Calculator folder listed in ContosoUniversity.csproj, the layout's navigation link, and CalculatorTests in IntegrationTests listed in IntegrationTests.csproj, shown by the compile control's MSBuild build and the Fixie console -- and Session 4, XML documentation comments on what session 3 added and a Razor comment atop its view, with no code, markup or project file changed. Each has a Register step and three or four work steps, and no release session is planned, because the brief names none.
